overloads.semanticRole: Sets aTable (or the default table if omitted) to read-only state for the calling process; subsequently loaded records of that table cannot be modified.
Sets every table to read-only state for the calling process, using the '*' form instead of naming a single table.

constraints: Not retroactive: a record's read-only/read-write status is fixed at the moment it is loaded, based on the table's state at that time. To load a record from a read/write table in read-only mode, change the table's state before loading it.
